content.description:
The future of Hive Keychain is not just about supporting Hive anymore. It’s about making Hive the easiest gateway into the broader crypto ecosystem. In this video, you can see Hive Keychain being used to:

* Log in to Altera from the @magi.network with an EVM account
* Interact with an EVM dApp directly through Keychain and holding Hive tokens at the same time
* Swap HIVE to HBD using Magi’s swap features

And the best part? Everything happens from the same wallet you already use every day: Hive Keychain.

This is exactly why Multichain matters. When Hive Keychain launches Multichain support, users will simply be able to add their EVM accounts directly into Keychain and use their favorite dApps, tokens, and networks without needing to constantly jump between wallets. No matter if you are using:

* Hive
* Hive Engine
* L2 ecosystems
* EVM chains
* Stablecoins
* NFTs
* Bridges
* Swaps

The goal is simple: **One wallet to rule all your tokens, across all your favorite ecosystems.**

This is also bigger than just convenience. By connecting Hive to EVM ecosystems, we are bringing Hive closer to millions of crypto users, making onboarding dramatically easier, expanding liquidity opportunities, and helping Hive stop feeling isolated from the rest of the industry.

Multichain is currently moving through testing phases, and every step gets us closer to opening this experience to the entire community. If you want to support this vision and help us continue building it, please vote for our latest DHF proposal.

[👉 Vote for the Hive Keychain Proposal](https://peakd.com/me/proposals/373)
